# Manim Studio

A free, open-source local creative studio, powered by Manim Community.

Create videos from editable templates for countdowns, interval timers, comparisons,
numbers, charts, announcements, quotes, and quizzes. Explore 30 Paper Shaders with
image and logo uploads, presets, and live controls. Templates export video and
images; shaders export PNG and WebM. Projects and assets are kept locally.

The website includes an interactive preview of three shaders and source setup
instructions. Python 3.11+ and Node.js 20.19+ are needed for the initial source build.

Website: https://manimgui.birol.tech/
Repository: https://github.com/birol-dev/Manim-Fullstack
